verses.en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.pt: Então foi conduzido Jesus pelo Espírito ao deserto, para ser tentado pelo Diabo.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus was sent by the Spirit into the waste land to be tested by the Evil One.

verses.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.pt: E, tendo jejuado quarenta dias e quarenta noites, depois teve fome.
verses.en_web: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
verses.en_bbe: And after going without food for forty days and forty nights, he was in need of it.

verses.en: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.pt: Chegando, então, o tentador, disse-lhe: Se tu és Filho de Deus manda que estas pedras se tornem em pães.
verses.en_web: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Evil One came and said to him, If you are the Son of God, give the word for these stones to become bread.

verses.en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus lhe respondeu: Está escrito: Nem só de pão viverá o homem, mas de toda palavra que sai da boca de Deus.
verses.en_web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”
verses.en_bbe: But he made answer and said, It is in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need, but every word which comes out of the mouth of God.

verses.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.pt: Então o Diabo o levou à cidade santa, colocou-o sobre o pináculo do templo,
verses.en_web: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
verses.en_bbe: Then the Evil One took him to the holy town; and he put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him,

verses.en: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.pt: e disse-lhe: Se tu és Filho de Deus, lança-te daqui abaixo; porque está escrito: Aos seus anjos dará ordens a teu respeito; e: eles te susterão nas mãos, para que nunca tropeces em alguma pedra.
verses.en_web: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you.’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
verses.en_bbe: If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down; for it is in the Writings, He will give his angels care over you; and, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.pt: Replicou-lhe Jesus: Também está escrito: Não tentarás o Senhor teu Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, Again it is in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.

verses.en: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.pt: Novamente o Diabo o levou a um monte muito alto; e mostrou-lhe todos os reinos do mundo, e a glória deles;
verses.en_web: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.
verses.en_bbe: Again, the Evil One took him up to a very high mountain, and let him see all the kingdoms of the world and the glory of them;

verses.en: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.pt: e disse-lhe: Tudo isto te darei, se, prostrado, me adorares.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, All these things will I give you, if you will go down on your face and give me worship.

verses.en: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.pt: Então ordenou-lhe Jesus: Vai-te, Satanás; porque está escrito: Ao Senhor teu Deus adorarás, e só a ele servirás.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then said Jesus to him, Away, Satan: for it is in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God and be his servant only.

verses.en: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.pt: Então o Diabo o deixou; e eis que vieram os anjos e o serviram.
verses.en_web: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Evil One went away from him, and angels came and took care of him.

verses.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.pt: Ora, ouvindo Jesus que João fora entregue, retirou-se para a Galiléia;
verses.en_web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: Now when it came to his ears that John had been put in prison, he went away to Galilee;

verses.en: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.pt: e, deixando Nazaré, foi habitar em Cafarnaum, cidade marítima, nos confins de Zabulom e Naftali;
verses.en_web: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
verses.en_bbe: And going away from Nazareth, he came and made his living-place in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the country of Zebulun and Naphtali:

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.pt: para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelo profeta Isaías:
verses.en_web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
verses.en_bbe: So that the word of the prophet Isaiah might come true,

verses.en: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
verses.pt: A terra de Zabulom e a terra de Naftali, o caminho do mar, além do Jordão, a Galiléia dos gentios,
verses.en_web: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
verses.en_bbe: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, by the way of the sea, the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

verses.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.pt: o povo que estava sentado em trevas viu uma grande luz; sim, aos que estavam sentados na região da sombra da morte, a estes a luz raiou.
verses.en_web: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
verses.en_bbe: The people who were in the dark saw a great light, and to those in the land of the shade of death did the dawn come up.

verses.en: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.pt: Desde então começou Jesus a pregar, e a dizer: Arrependei- vos, porque é chegado o reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
verses.en_bbe: From that time Jesus went about preaching and saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin, for the kingdom of heaven is near.

verses.en: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.pt: E Jesus, andando ao longo do mar da Galiléia, viu dois irmãos - Simão, chamado Pedro, e seu irmão André, os quais lançavam a rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores.
verses.en_web: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verses.en_bbe: And when he was walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon, whose other name was Peter, and Andrew, his brother, who were putting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes: Vinde após mim, e eu vos farei pescadores de homens.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.en: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.pt: Eles, pois, deixando imediatamente as redes, o seguiram.
verses.en_web: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away they let go the nets and went after him.

verses.en: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.pt: E, passando mais adiante, viu outros dois irmãos - Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João, no barco com seu pai Zebedeu, consertando as redes; e os chamou.
verses.en_web: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
verses.en_bbe: And going on from there he saw two other brothers, James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, in the boat with their father, stitching up their nets; and he said, Come.

verses.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.pt: Estes, deixando imediatamente o barco e seu pai, seguiram- no.
verses.en_web: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And they went straight from the boat and their father and came after him.

verses.en: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.pt: E percorria Jesus toda a Galiléia, ensinando nas sinagogas, pregando o evangelho do reino, e curando todas as doenças e enfermidades entre o povo.
verses.en_web: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their Synagogues and preaching the good news of the kingdom, and making well those who were ill with any disease among the people.

verses.en: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.pt: Assim a sua fama correu por toda a Síria; e trouxeram-lhe todos os que padeciam, acometidos de várias doenças e tormentos, os endemoninhados, os lunáticos, e os paralíticos; e ele os curou.
verses.en_web: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
verses.en_bbe: And news of him went out through all Syria; and they took to him all who were ill with different diseases and pains, those having evil spirits and those who were off their heads, and those who had no power of moving. And he made them well.

verses.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.pt: De sorte que o seguiam grandes multidões da Galiléia, de Decápolis, de Jerusalém, da Judéia, e dalém do Jordão.
verses.en_web: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And there went after him great numbers from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judaea and from the other side of Jordan.
